title: Spin-Alignment Entropy Conjecture
exact_target: For fixed mixing weights and fixed one-spin noise, decide whether aligning every variable spin with a largest-eigenvalue eigenvector minimizes entropy.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004866 (OWR-8415352-008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Geometry and Optimization in Quantum Information (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/49, pp. 2665--2720. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The primary presentation starts with spin-one-half states, so an arbitrary finite-dimensional one-spin space is the broader catalogue formulation. The weights and fixed-spin subsets are held fixed in the minimization. Degeneracy of the largest eigenvalue allows any corresponding unit eigenvector; the conjecture does not assert uniqueness.
